data.gender_notes: Devipriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devi (goddess) + priya (beloved, dear one). The name Devipriya is a tribute to the divine love and blessings of the goddess. The name Devipriya carries the meaning “Goddess's love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devipriya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess's love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies divine love and blessings.
data.etymology: Devipriya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess's love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devipriya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Devipriya holds immense spiritual significance as it pays homage to the divine mother, a symbol of love, compassion, and strength. It is believed that invoking the blessings of Devi can lead towards a joyful and fulfilling life. The name is often given to girls to instill a deep sense of respect and devotion towards the divine female principle.
